tools.name: integrations_getOverview
tools.description: Get an aggregated overview of all configured providers for the brand. Returns per-provider key counts, active/healthy counts, daily capacity and spend totals.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: integrations_listProviders
tools.description: List available provider templates with their required credential fields and default limits.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: integrations_listIntegrations
tools.description: List all integration keys for the brand, optionally filtered by provider name. Returns key previews, health status, usage counters and spend data.

provider_name.description: Filter by provider name (e.g. spideriq, smartlead)

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: integrations_getIntegration
tools.description: Get details for a single integration key including preview, health status, usage and spend limits.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: integrations_createIntegration
tools.description: Create a new API integration key. Requires provider_name and a credentials object with the provider's required fields. Brand admin only.

is_primary.description: Set as primary key for this provider

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: integrations_updateIntegration
tools.description: Update an existing integration key. Supports partial updates for label, credentials, limits, priority, active status, and spend limits. Brand admin only.

integration_id.description: The integration key ID to update

is_primary.description: Set as primary key for this provider

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: integrations_deleteIntegration
tools.description: Delete an integration key permanently. Also deregisters associated services (e.g. SpiderMail mailboxes). Brand admin only.

integration_id.description: The integration key ID to delete

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: integrations_resetUsage
tools.description: Reset daily and minute usage counters for an integration key. Brand admin only.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: integrations_getSpend
tools.description: Get spend details for a single integration key including cached balance, daily and monthly usage, and currency.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: integrations_getProviderSpend
tools.description: Get aggregated spend overview for all keys of a specific provider. Includes per-key snapshots with balance, daily/monthly usage.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: integrations_syncBilling
tools.description: Trigger a billing sync for an integration key. Fetches current balance and usage from the provider API. Brand admin only.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)
